adjudication.rationale: The diff verifies the API behavior change: `Admin::GroupsController#update` previously read `payload = params[:group]` and applied `payload[:usernames]` to change membership; it now only reads top-level `params[:alias_level]`, `params[:visible]`, and (non-automatic) `params[:name]`, with membership moved to new `add_members`/`remove_member` endpoints (`put/delete "members"` routes). As a result, a legacy client sending `PUT /admin/groups/:id` with `group[usernames]=...` will receive a 200 `success_json` (if the other fields save) while membership is ignored—this is a diff-grounded compatibility concern rather than an internal correctness defect.
